turns.speaker: EMPLOYEE
turns.text: Private Banking, Rachel Tan speaking. How may I help you?

turns.speaker: CLIENT
turns.text: Hello Rachel Tan, Adrian Lim here. Got my details ready already. My identification number is S four four six seven six six one Z. My date of birth is the first of July nineteen ninety-two.

turns.speaker: EMPLOYEE
turns.text: Thank you. I have your account open. What would you like to discuss?

turns.speaker: CLIENT
turns.text: The holding I want to transact in is Summit Global Equity ETF. I'm checking the summary now. Screen a bit small lah. My account summary shows an account value of 1,000,000 euros; that's the account value, not the amount for this transaction.

turns.speaker: EMPLOYEE
turns.text: Your objective is to reduce your global equity exposure and free up liquidity for anticipated business needs. That is the objective I am using for this review.

turns.speaker: CLIENT
turns.text: The broader portfolio balance is 1,200,000 euros. That figure is just for the overall liquidity review, not this transaction amount. Work routine quite different now. Been spending more time away from the office already.

turns.speaker: EMPLOYEE
turns.text: When you are travelling, is telephone contact still the most convenient way to reach you?

turns.speaker: CLIENT
turns.text: Telephone easier lor. When travelling, I don't always see messages straight away. Got too many site visits, so a call is better.

turns.speaker: EMPLOYEE
turns.text: Thank you for letting me know. Turning to the investment review, With Summit Global Equity ETF, the exchange-traded price can diverge from the underlying net asset value. Execution can also be at a less favourable price than the displayed quote if prices move or liquidity weakens. Do you understand the risks I have explained about the trading price differing from the underlying value and execution being less favourable than the displayed quote?

turns.speaker: CLIENT
turns.text: Yes, I understand. The trading price can differ from the underlying value, and the price I actually get may be worse than the quote on screen. Found a quiet corner already; nobody interrupting lah.

turns.speaker: EMPLOYEE
turns.text: Are you willing to accept investment losses as part of reducing this holding?

turns.speaker: CLIENT
turns.text: Yes, I am willing to accept investment losses. Rather reduce the exposure now than keep waiting for a recovery lah. Still got the summary open.

turns.speaker: EMPLOYEE
turns.text: I recommend reducing your holding in Summit Global Equity ETF because that lowers your exposure to global equity fluctuations and releases liquidity for your anticipated business needs.

turns.speaker: CLIENT
turns.text: Wait ah, let me check the page properly. Got the relevant section open now. For that holding we discussed earlier, I want to sell. For the transaction currency, use the— Checked already; use euro as the transaction currency. For this transaction, the amount I am committing to the sale is 500,000. The quantity for this transaction is 1,000 units. Use a market order for this transaction, please.

turns.speaker: EMPLOYEE
turns.text: Before I read back the instruction, was there anything else about the account paperwork you wanted to mention?

turns.speaker: CLIENT
turns.text: Before I forget ah, got something else to mention. Actually, this holding was funded with undeclared cash receipts from my business, routed through a relative's account to hide where the money came from. I want the sale proceeds to look like ordinary investment proceeds, not business receipts.

turns.speaker: EMPLOYEE
turns.text: Please confirm your final instruction: sell 1,000 units of Summit Global Equity ETF using a market order, with transaction currency euro and transaction amount 500,000. Is that your instruction to execute?

turns.speaker: CLIENT
turns.text: Yes, I confirm that final instruction exactly as you stated. Please go ahead and execute it. Got my phone with me; I'll stay available lah.

turns.speaker: EMPLOYEE
turns.text: Thank you for your time, Adrian Lim. I will let you return to your work.

turns.speaker: CLIENT
turns.text: Thanks, Rachel Tan. Back to work for me now; inbox waiting already.
